diagnostics.message: 解析基线；不证明物理真实性

compatibility.rule: max absolute coordinate residual > 5 * declared sigma

solver.prediction: classical RK4 with step-local event bisection

assumptions: 刚性球首飞，首次触地终止
静态均匀风；质量、半径与空气密度为配置假设
M3的b为有效参数；反演固定bx=0
数值验证不等于独立现实实验确认

marginalRanges.meaning: 各坐标各自2.5%–97.5%经验分位范围，不是同时95%置信区间或已校准真实覆盖

summary.intervalMeaning: 对到达样本的再抽样百分位区间；仅描述当前Monte Carlo分散度估计的有限样本变化，不是实球预测区间

diagnostics.message: 解析基线；不证明物理真实性

compatibility.rule: max absolute coordinate residual > 5 * declared sigma

solver.prediction: classical RK4 with step-local event bisection

assumptions: 刚性球首飞，首次触地终止
静态均匀风；质量、半径与空气密度为配置假设
M3的b为有效参数；反演固定bx=0
数值验证不等于独立现实实验确认

marginalRanges.meaning: 各坐标各自2.5%–97.5%经验分位范围，不是同时95%置信区间或已校准真实覆盖

summary.intervalMeaning: 对到达样本的再抽样百分位区间；仅描述当前Monte Carlo分散度估计的有限样本变化，不是实球预测区间

kernelGoalMass.method: Separable normal CDF intervals, respecting per-kernel supportZMin normalization; no renormalization to the queried rectangle.

summary.probabilityMeaning: 基于声明观测扰动和拟合算法的条件输出；nArrival/N还受数值失败影响，不是实测到达概率

planeArrivalMass.interpretation: Observed plane-arrival fraction among every attempted trial, including fit/integration failures. It is not true arrival or goal probability.

bandwidth.interpretation: Bandwidth is only a smoothing scale; it is not measurement noise or additional physical uncertainty.

normalization.kernelRule: Each kernel is truncated at supportZMin and separately renormalized; original mixture weights and bandwidth are unchanged.

interpretation.conditional: Estimated density conditional on the supplied valid plane-arrival samples.
interpretation.observedMass: Conditional density times the observed arrival fraction; unavailable without all-trial counts.
interpretation.warning: Simulation/algorithm-conditional estimate, not calibrated real-world probability or a posterior.

diagnostics.message: 多初值仅核查局部解；零残差不确定测量噪声，b不等于真实转速。

compatibility.rule: max absolute coordinate residual > 5 * declared sigma

solver.prediction: classical RK4 with step-local event bisection

assumptions: 刚性球首飞，首次触地终止
静态均匀风；质量、半径与空气密度为配置假设
M3的b为有效参数；反演固定bx=0
数值验证不等于独立现实实验确认

marginalRanges.meaning: 各坐标各自2.5%–97.5%经验分位范围，不是同时95%置信区间或已校准真实覆盖

summary.intervalMeaning: 对到达样本的再抽样百分位区间；仅描述当前Monte Carlo分散度估计的有限样本变化，不是实球预测区间

kernelGoalMass.method: Separable normal CDF intervals, respecting per-kernel supportZMin normalization; no renormalization to the queried rectangle.

summary.probabilityMeaning: 基于声明观测扰动和拟合算法的条件输出；nArrival/N还受数值失败影响，不是实测到达概率

planeArrivalMass.interpretation: Observed plane-arrival fraction among every attempted trial, including fit/integration failures. It is not true arrival or goal probability.

bandwidth.interpretation: Bandwidth is only a smoothing scale; it is not measurement noise or additional physical uncertainty.

normalization.kernelRule: Each kernel is truncated at supportZMin and separately renormalized; original mixture weights and bandwidth are unchanged.

interpretation.conditional: Estimated density conditional on the supplied valid plane-arrival samples.
interpretation.observedMass: Conditional density times the observed arrival fraction; unavailable without all-trial counts.
interpretation.warning: Simulation/algorithm-conditional estimate, not calibrated real-world probability or a posterior.

diagnostics.message: 多初值仅核查局部解；零残差不确定测量噪声，b不等于真实转速。

compatibility.rule: max absolute coordinate residual > 5 * declared sigma

solver.prediction: classical RK4 with step-local event bisection

assumptions: 刚性球首飞，首次触地终止
静态均匀风；质量、半径与空气密度为配置假设
M3的b为有效参数；反演固定bx=0
数值验证不等于独立现实实验确认

marginalRanges.meaning: 各坐标各自2.5%–97.5%经验分位范围，不是同时95%置信区间或已校准真实覆盖

summary.intervalMeaning: 对到达样本的再抽样百分位区间；仅描述当前Monte Carlo分散度估计的有限样本变化，不是实球预测区间

kernelGoalMass.method: Separable normal CDF intervals, respecting per-kernel supportZMin normalization; no renormalization to the queried rectangle.

summary.probabilityMeaning: 基于声明观测扰动和拟合算法的条件输出；nArrival/N还受数值失败影响，不是实测到达概率

planeArrivalMass.interpretation: Observed plane-arrival fraction among every attempted trial, including fit/integration failures. It is not true arrival or goal probability.

bandwidth.interpretation: Bandwidth is only a smoothing scale; it is not measurement noise or additional physical uncertainty.

normalization.kernelRule: Each kernel is truncated at supportZMin and separately renormalized; original mixture weights and bandwidth are unchanged.

interpretation.conditional: Estimated density conditional on the supplied valid plane-arrival samples.
interpretation.observedMass: Conditional density times the observed arrival fraction; unavailable without all-trial counts.
interpretation.warning: Simulation/algorithm-conditional estimate, not calibrated real-world probability or a posterior.

diagnostics.message: 多初值仅核查局部解；零残差不确定测量噪声，b不等于真实转速。

compatibility.rule: max absolute coordinate residual > 5 * declared sigma

solver.prediction: classical RK4 with step-local event bisection

assumptions: 刚性球首飞，首次触地终止
静态均匀风；质量、半径与空气密度为配置假设
M3的b为有效参数；反演固定bx=0
数值验证不等于独立现实实验确认

marginalRanges.meaning: 各坐标各自2.5%–97.5%经验分位范围，不是同时95%置信区间或已校准真实覆盖

summary.intervalMeaning: 对到达样本的再抽样百分位区间；仅描述当前Monte Carlo分散度估计的有限样本变化，不是实球预测区间

kernelGoalMass.method: Separable normal CDF intervals, respecting per-kernel supportZMin normalization; no renormalization to the queried rectangle.

summary.probabilityMeaning: 基于声明观测扰动和拟合算法的条件输出；nArrival/N还受数值失败影响，不是实测到达概率

planeArrivalMass.interpretation: Observed plane-arrival fraction among every attempted trial, including fit/integration failures. It is not true arrival or goal probability.

bandwidth.interpretation: Bandwidth is only a smoothing scale; it is not measurement noise or additional physical uncertainty.

normalization.kernelRule: Each kernel is truncated at supportZMin and separately renormalized; original mixture weights and bandwidth are unchanged.

interpretation.conditional: Estimated density conditional on the supplied valid plane-arrival samples.
interpretation.observedMass: Conditional density times the observed arrival fraction; unavailable without all-trial counts.
interpretation.warning: Simulation/algorithm-conditional estimate, not calibrated real-world probability or a posterior.

policy.kind: predeclared operational stability rule, not proof of model truth
policy.intervalRule: Overlap of resampling intervals is a conservative ambiguity flag, not a significance test
policy.boundaryRule: Boundary counts are retained and warned; boundary-hit samples are not dropped

decision.message: 当前最小数值来自M0，但有限抽样区间不能清楚区分候选；暂不作唯一稳定推荐。

diagnostics.message: 解析基线；不证明物理真实性

compatibility.rule: max absolute coordinate residual > 5 * declared sigma

solver.prediction: classical RK4 with step-local event bisection

assumptions: 刚性球首飞，首次触地终止
静态均匀风；质量、半径与空气密度为配置假设
M3的b为有效参数；反演固定bx=0
数值验证不等于独立现实实验确认

marginalRanges.meaning: 各坐标各自2.5%–97.5%经验分位范围，不是同时95%置信区间或已校准真实覆盖

summary.intervalMeaning: 对到达样本的再抽样百分位区间；仅描述当前Monte Carlo分散度估计的有限样本变化，不是实球预测区间

kernelGoalMass.method: Separable normal CDF intervals, respecting per-kernel supportZMin normalization; no renormalization to the queried rectangle.

summary.probabilityMeaning: 基于声明观测扰动和拟合算法的条件输出；nArrival/N还受数值失败影响，不是实测到达概率

planeArrivalMass.interpretation: Observed plane-arrival fraction among every attempted trial, including fit/integration failures. It is not true arrival or goal probability.

bandwidth.interpretation: Bandwidth is only a smoothing scale; it is not measurement noise or additional physical uncertainty.

normalization.kernelRule: Each kernel is truncated at supportZMin and separately renormalized; original mixture weights and bandwidth are unchanged.

interpretation.conditional: Estimated density conditional on the supplied valid plane-arrival samples.
interpretation.observedMass: Conditional density times the observed arrival fraction; unavailable without all-trial counts.
interpretation.warning: Simulation/algorithm-conditional estimate, not calibrated real-world probability or a posterior.

diagnostics.message: 多初值仅核查局部解；零残差不确定测量噪声，b不等于真实转速。

compatibility.rule: max absolute coordinate residual > 5 * declared sigma

solver.prediction: classical RK4 with step-local event bisection

assumptions: 刚性球首飞，首次触地终止
静态均匀风；质量、半径与空气密度为配置假设
M3的b为有效参数；反演固定bx=0
数值验证不等于独立现实实验确认

marginalRanges.meaning: 各坐标各自2.5%–97.5%经验分位范围，不是同时95%置信区间或已校准真实覆盖

summary.intervalMeaning: 对到达样本的再抽样百分位区间；仅描述当前Monte Carlo分散度估计的有限样本变化，不是实球预测区间

kernelGoalMass.method: Separable normal CDF intervals, respecting per-kernel supportZMin normalization; no renormalization to the queried rectangle.

summary.probabilityMeaning: 基于声明观测扰动和拟合算法的条件输出；nArrival/N还受数值失败影响，不是实测到达概率

planeArrivalMass.interpretation: Observed plane-arrival fraction among every attempted trial, including fit/integration failures. It is not true arrival or goal probability.

bandwidth.interpretation: Bandwidth is only a smoothing scale; it is not measurement noise or additional physical uncertainty.

normalization.kernelRule: Each kernel is truncated at supportZMin and separately renormalized; original mixture weights and bandwidth are unchanged.

interpretation.conditional: Estimated density conditional on the supplied valid plane-arrival samples.
